result.description:
Main Activities
Designing, coding, testing and installing applications programs up to 75% of the time, either in one major program or a range of programs across multiple platforms.
Preparing and maintaining systems and program documentation.
Assisting in the analysis and design of applications programs and databases.
Modifying and troubleshooting applications programs.
Liaising with users.

Core responsibilities:
Development:
· Work with Business Analysts to analyse business processes, procedures and user requirements in order to establish system requirements.
· Participate in system design including production of system and program documentation as well as ongoing maintenance
· Develop solutions and specifications so that agreed requirements can be converted into functional systems
· Develop, program and code technology applications software solutions to meet agreed specifications. Improve, enhance and correct systems as necessary
· Achieve key Systems Development Life Cycle stages in terms of quantity, timing and quality of all aspects of work allocated
· Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with required standards, methods and procedures
Support:
· Create development and support documentation and provide advice regarding applications to enable support function to work pro-actively
· Contribute to conduct of post implementation reviews to assess the effectiveness of the testing solution provided
· Contribute to the review and redesign of processes or procedures, on an ongoing basis, to deliver improved team productivity or efficiency
· Provide key support on fail and fix for assigned application/s
Testing:
· Undertake complex testing activities in relation to software solutions ensuring these meet agreed specifications
· Develop comprehensive test scripts and scenarios based on testing plan in accordance with standard procedures and templates
· Execute test cases, check and document results to ensure the systems technical, functional and non-functional (e.g. elementary load testing) requirements are met
· Contribute to testing of any actions taken to rectify users# problems to ensure user and system requirements are met and that changes integrate with production system
· Make initial diagnosis of problems, for a system or sub-system or apply known solutions, including documenting problems, progress checking, and escalation to ensure resolution
Additional responsibilities:
· Appropriately use progress/tracking tools and complete administration activities
· Test, launch and help train users in new systems
· Work with business users (in conjunction with Business Analysts) to clarify requirements, resolve issues
· Document systems and produce desk procedures for ongoing user use. End user support/ 2nd level Help Desk
· Contribute to maintaining operating environments to enable testing which reflects user environments
· May undertake evaluation and quality reviews of system development processes and practices and thereby contribute to the overall effectiveness of the function/ team.

Salary $80K - $95K

result.description:
About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced AI & Data Architect to lead the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-scale Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Data Platform solutions.
This role is responsible for defining the enterprise AI and data architecture, establishing governance frameworks, and designing scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions. The successful candidate will bridge Data Architecture, AI Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Enterprise Architecture, ensuring AI capabilities are aligned with business strategy while remaining flexible and independent of any single technology vendor.

The environment includes AWS Bedrock, Snowflake Cortex, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), modern data platforms, and enterprise foundation models including Anthropic Claude.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data engineers, AI engineers, security teams, and cloud architects to build enterprise AI capabilities that are secure, governed, scalable, and future-ready.

Key ResponsibilitiesAI & Enterprise Architecture

Define the enterprise AI strategy and target architecture.
Design scalable AI and data platforms supporting enterprise-wide AI adoption.
Develop AI reference architectures, standards, and architectural principles.
Ensure AI solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, governance, and business objectives.
Design vendor-agnostic AI architectures to avoid dependency on a single LLM or cloud provider.
Lead AI solution architecture reviews and technology selection.
Data Architecture

Design modern enterprise data architectures supporting AI and advanced analytics.
Develop enterprise semantic data models and knowledge architectures.
Design scalable data ingestion, transformation, and integration frameworks.
Define data governance, metadata management, master data management, and data quality standards.
Architect data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse solutions.
Ensure enterprise data platforms support AI, analytics, and business intelligence.
AI Governance & Responsible AI

Define AI governance frameworks.
Establish AI safety guardrails and responsible AI policies.
Design evaluation frameworks for AI quality, hallucination detection, and model performance.
Define governance for prompt management, model lifecycle management, and AI observability.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, privacy, and enterprise governance requirements.
Cloud & Platform Architecture

Design cloud-native AI platforms on AWS and Snowflake.
Architect scalable, resilient, and secure AI workloads.
Define Infrastructure as Code and automation standards.
Design API-first architectures for AI services.
Support enterprise integration using event-driven and microservices architectures.

Next Steps
If you are passionate about AI & Data Engineering and have the necessary skills and experience, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: From 120,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation.

About Loginet Technologies

Loginet Technologies is an Australian technology consulting and digital transformation company committed to helping businesses leverage innovative technologies to improve efficiency, productivity, and sustainable growth. We deliver end-to-end ICT solutions across managed IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software and mobile application development, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent business automation, DevOps, enterprise networking, telecommunications, digital transformation, infrastructure management, ERP and CRM solutions, and managed technology support. Our experienced team works closely with organisations across diverse industries to design, implement, integrate, and support secure, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions that drive business innovation and operational excellence.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ICT Project Manager to lead the successful planning, execution and delivery of complex ICT projects across software development, AI solutions, business automation, cloud services, cybersecurity and digital transformation initiatives.

Working closely with clients, business stakeholders and multidisciplinary technical teams, you will manage the complete project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the complete lifecycle of ICT projects from initiation through planning, execution, implementation and closure.

•	Lead software development, cloud migration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent automation and digital transformation projects.

•	Collaborate with clients to gather business requirements and translate them into successful project outcomes.

•	Develop project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones and resource allocation plans.

•	Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, AI engineers, cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, business analysts and cybersecurity specialists.

•	Manage Agile, Scrum and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

•	Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, issues and quality standards while ensuring successful project delivery.

•	Facilitate project workshops, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, stakeholder meetings and executive reporting.

•	Manage project governance, change requests, risk mitigation and quality assurance activities.

•	Coordinate with third-party vendors and technology partners to support successful project implementation.

•	Ensure successful deployment, client acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover following project completion.

•	Continuously improve project management processes and delivery frameworks across the organisation.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

•	Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a closely related ICT discipline.

•	Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects.

•	Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure or digital transformation projects.

•	Experience managing Agile and Scrum software development projects.

•	Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

•	Excellent leadership, communication and organisational abilities.

•	Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks and multidisciplinary project teams.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills

•	Experience with workflow automation platforms including n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make.com or similar technologies.

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Trello, Monday.com or similar project management platforms.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

Why Join Loginet Technologies?

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.
